observation_summary: The ChecksumCalculatingInputStream class allowed null parameters to be passed to its constructor, which later caused a NullPointerException when the object was used (e.g., calling getValue()).
hypothesis: The constructor lacked input validation (null checks) for its parameters, allowing the object to be initialized in an invalid state.
prediction: The code will be updated to include explicit null checks at the beginning of the constructor, throwing an exception if either parameter is null.
experiment_rationale: The fix provided in the bug report explicitly adds 'if (checksum == null)' and 'if (in == null)' checks to the constructor, which confirms that the root cause was a missing validation guard.
reasoning_summary: The defect is a classic missing guard/validation check. The constructor failed to validate its input parameters, leading to an invalid object state. Adding these checks is the definition of a 'Checking' ODC type.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix involves the constructor (initialization), the root cause is the lack of validation logic (guards) for the parameters, not an incorrect value assignment.
